title: Lightly Steamed Australian Khus Khus Bowls
description: A delicate Australian dish featuring the subtle flavors of khus khus, perfect for a romantic dinner or light meal.

ingredients.name: olive oil
ingredients.notes: use a mild, Australian olive oil

ingredients.name: Australian bush herbs (such as lemon myrtle or kakadu plum)

instructions: Rinse the khus khus under cold running water and drain well.
In a medium saucepan, bring 4 cups of water to a boil.
Add the quinoa to the saucepan and reduce heat to low.
Cover the saucepan with a lid and simmer for 15-20 minutes, or until the quinoa is tender and the water has been absorbed.
While the quinoa cooks, combine the Australian bush tomato relish, lemon juice, and olive oil in a small bowl.
Stir to combine and set aside.
Once the quinoa is cooked, fluff it with a fork and add the khus khus to the saucepan.
Stir to combine and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the khus khus is lightly toasted.
Season the khus khus mixture with salt to taste.
To serve, divide the khus khus mixture among four bowls and top each bowl with a spoonful of the bush tomato relish mixture.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and sprinkle with Australian bush herbs, if desired.
